title: QEVN Website Opportunity Lead Finder Input

locations.title: Target Locations
locations.description: List of cities or regions to search in (e.g., 'Rajkot, Gujarat, India', 'Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India').

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max Results Per Query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of discovery results per location + search query combination.

websiteFilter.title: Website Filter Mode
websiteFilter.description: Filter businesses by website status: WITHOUT_WEBSITE (only businesses without official websites), WITH_WEBSITE (only businesses with official websites), or ALL.

requirePhone.title: Require Public Phone
requirePhone.description: When enabled, businesses without a public phone number are filtered out.

enrichSocialProfiles.title: Enrich Social Profiles
enrichSocialProfiles.description: Discover and match public Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Pinterest profiles.

enrichEmails.title: Enrich Public Emails (Safe)
enrichEmails.description: Extract publicly visible business contact emails from legitimate public business pages.

searchEngineEnrichment.title: Search Engine Verification & Enrichment
searchEngineEnrichment.description: Perform targeted public web queries (1–3 max) to verify website status and discover public business profiles.

minimumLeadScore.title: Minimum Lead Score
minimumLeadScore.description: Only export leads with a score equal to or higher than this threshold (0–100 scale).

excludeClosedBusinesses.title: Exclude Closed Businesses
excludeClosedBusinesses.description: Exclude permanently or temporarily closed businesses from lead results.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of concurrent enrichment and verification requests.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for network requests.

discoveryProvider.title: Discovery Provider
discoveryProvider.description: Provider to use for business discovery: 'apify_actor' calls an existing Google Maps Actor, or 'direct_fallback' executes standalone crawler.

mapsActorId.title: Apify Google Maps Actor ID
mapsActorId.description: Apify Actor ID to call when discoveryProvider is 'apify_actor'.
